# defectdojo_regulation (List Resource)

Lists the DefectDojo regulations, ordered by ID, including those DefectDojo comes with.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Terraform returns at most 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`. `terraform query -generate-config-out` writes every attribute that has a value, including those the provider otherwise leaves to others when they are not configured (such as `authorized_users` and `tags`): remove the ones another system manages before applying the generated configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the regulations, including those DefectDojo comes with, and generate import blocks and
# configuration with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "defectdojo_regulation" "all" {
  provider = defectdojo
}

# Only those whose name contains "gdpr", ignoring case
list "defectdojo_regulation" "filtered" {
  provider = defectdojo

  config {
    name_contains = "gdpr"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Only list the regulations whose name contains this text, ignoring case.
